- No exclusion keywords like "Zahlungserinnerung" or "Mahnung" prominent.

Locate required fields (verify alternatives and choose most consistent occurrences):

1) Invoice.Date
- Found near top-right: "Datum 10.01.2024".
- No other competing date that appears as invoice issue date. Use "10.01.2024" (DD.MM.YYYY).

2) Sender.VatId
- Found in header: "VAT Registration n° ATU39103108".
- Also repeated in footer. Use "ATU39103108".

3) Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount (Vat group)
- There is an MwSt. summary table near bottom:
  - Column headings show "MwSt.-%" and "MwSt.-€" and net/gross totals.
  - Row: "10,00 %", "93,00", "930,00", "93,00", "930,00", "1.023,00"
- Interpret as VAT rate = 10% (record as number 10).
- Net amount corresponding to this VAT group = 930,00 (EUR) -> record 930.00 preserving two decimals.
- VAT amount = 93,00 (EUR) -> record 93.00.

Confirm no other VAT groups present:
- Only one VAT row (10%) visible. No other rates.

4) GrandTotal.Amount
- Gross total (Gesamtsumme brutto) shown as "1.023,00" EUR.
- There is also a discounted payment line showing "Zahlung bis 09.02.2024 2,000% EUR 1.002,54" (early payment net after 2% discount), but the invoice gross payable amount is the Gesamtsumme brutto 1.023,00.
- Use 1023.00 preserving two decimals.

No inference beyond visible values. All extracted values match explicit text; decimals preserved and percentage recorded without "%" as integer.
